prompts.states: Use case: stylized-concept. Production body-only transparent full-body animation sprite sheet for a Ben10 fan fighting game. Nanomech in Ben 10 Alien Swarm/Ultimate Alien cartoon form: small lean green/silver biomechanical insect humanoid, large green eyes, two thin antennae with green tips, two translucent insect wings, narrow silver/green body, small claw-like manipulator hands and slim insect feet, chest Omnitrix. Maintain the exact same tiny insect anatomy and wing design throughout; no bulky robot armor. Reference image supplies identity/colors only; follow the explicit classic anatomy corrections. Clean authentic TV cartoon cel style: crisp black outlines, simple flat colors with ONE hard-edged shade, consistent model proportions in every pose, no photorealism, gradients, surface texture, water, glow or power effects. Exactly EIGHT separate complete full-body poses in a four-column/two-row grid; generous transparent gutters and outer margins; same three-quarter side camera facing SCREEN-RIGHT throughout. Top row:1 ultimate preparation stance;2 ultimate release: both small manipulator arms extended, wings spread for stable airborne electric overload, no drawn electricity;3 recovery to guarded rest;4 neutral standing/hovering hero stance. Bottom row:5 character-specific defensive guard;6 nonlethal standing/hovering hit recoil (still alive, never lying down);7 defeated prone on ground;8 dash: fast forward aerial dart with body tilted and wings swept back. Do not change head size, torso width, palette, emblem placement or limb count between poses. No text, no labels, no grids. High native detail; wide2:1 landscape canvas about2048x1024.
